hero.title: About MENASCO
hero.description: Founded in the UAE in 1994, MENASCO is an MEP contractor delivering mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems for high-rise, hospitality, infrastructure and mission-critical projects, with offices in seven countries.
hero.filmAlt: Film of MENASCO engineers and site teams at work, from fire protection and electrical panels to project coordination

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.paragraph1: MENASCO Mechanical Contracting LLC is one of MENA's leading providers of integrated MEP engineering and contracting solutions, delivering high-performance building services across commercial, residential, hospitality, energy, healthcare, and mission-critical developments.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: Founded in 1994, MENASCO has earned a reputation for engineering precision, technical excellence, and reliable project delivery. Today, our footprint spans seven global locations, allowing us to support clients across MENA, Europe, and North America with consistent quality, innovation, and operational excellence.
whoWeAre.paragraph3: Our multidisciplinary teams combine engineering expertise, advanced technologies, and collaborative project management to deliver complete lifecycle MEP solutions, from design coordination and BIM integration through installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
whoWeAre.quote: At MENASCO, we do more than install systems; we engineer environments that perform.

ourApproach.heading: Engineering Built Around Performance
ourApproach.filmAlt: MENASCO film: what drives every milestone, from innovation and integrity to safety and commitment
ourApproach.description: At MENASCO, our approach is built on early collaboration, integrated engineering, and disciplined execution. By aligning technical expertise, digital technologies, and project delivery teams throughout every stage of construction, we navigate complexity, anticipate challenges, and deliver systems that meet the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and long-term performance.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be the MEP partner the world turns to when failure is not an option.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To deliver MEP engineering that powers our collective future: innovative in method, uncompromising in quality, and honest in every commitment we make.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: Transforming visionary ideas into practical engineering solutions.

integrity.title: Integrity

excellence.title: Excellence

qualityStandards.heading: Commitment to Quality
qualityStandards.paragraph1: Quality is embedded into every stage of our operations. MENASCO operates under an integrated Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental (QHSE) management framework that promotes continuous improvement, proactive risk management, and operational excellence across every project.
qualityStandards.paragraph2: Our commitment extends beyond compliance. Through rigorous quality control, technical oversight, and performance monitoring, we consistently deliver engineering solutions that meet the highest standards expected throughout the construction industry. This commitment enables us to deliver projects that are safe, reliable, efficient, and built for long-term performance.

ourPeople.heading: Driven by Exceptional People
ourPeople.paragraph1: Behind every successful MENASCO project is a team of highly experienced engineers, project managers, technical specialists, and construction professionals united by a shared commitment to excellence.
ourPeople.paragraph2: Our people combine decades of technical expertise with collaborative problem-solving, enabling us to deliver turnkey engineering solutions for some of the world's most demanding developments.
ourPeople.paragraph3: Through continuous professional development, advanced technologies, and a culture of accountability, our teams consistently exceed client expectations while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and integrity.

featured.heading: Leadership

engineeringSupport.heading: Technical Leadership
engineeringSupport.description: The leaders driving MENASCO's engineering, digital and specialist functions.

Mr. Hani Badawiyeh: Mr. Hani Badawiyeh is a seasoned financial leader with over 22 years of experience in financial management, accounting, and strategic analysis. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Financial Management and Accounting from the University of Jordan and has been a cornerstone in MENASCO's administrative and financial framework.

Throughout his distinguished career, Mr. Badawiyeh has demonstrated exceptional expertise in budget planning, financial reporting, and contract oversight, ensuring fiscal discipline and sustainable growth across all business operations.

His analytical precision and strategic approach have been instrumental in implementing effective financial governance, enhancing transparency, and optimizing performance efficiency, key pillars that uphold MENASCO's values of Integrity, Innovation, and Excellence.
Eng. Refad Al-Dwairi: Eng. Refad Al-Dwairi is a seasoned engineering and project management professional with over 20 years of experience delivering large-scale construction projects across regional and international markets. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the Jordan University of Science and Technology and an MBA from the University of Manchester, UK.

Recognized for blending technical precision with strategic leadership, Eng. Refad has successfully led numerous high-profile projects to completion, consistently achieving exceptional results in time, cost, and quality performance while ensuring full compliance with contractual, safety, and international standards.

As Chief Operating Officer of MENASCO, he plays a pivotal role in strengthening the company's operational capabilities and reinforcing its enduring commitment to Innovation, Integrity, and Excellence.
Eng. Ihab Saadi: Eng. Ihab Saadi is a seasoned construction and workforce management leader with over 25 years of experience in large-scale project execution, resource planning, and operational leadership. He oversees strategic workforce initiatives, ensuring seamless coordination across diverse teams.

Renowned for balancing strategic planning with on-the-ground execution, Eng. Saadi has successfully managed numerous high-profile and complex projects, demonstrating exceptional skill in resource optimization, budget control, and performance enhancement.
His leadership philosophy centers on empowerment, precision, and teamwork, driving innovation and fostering collaboration across all departments.
Eng. Mohamed Youssef: Eng. Mohamed Youssef brings over 15 years of extensive experience in contract management, commercial operations, and project administration across major construction and infrastructure developments. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from Alexandria University.

His credentials include membership of FIDIC (International Federation of Consulting Engineers), a Six Sigma certification in Leadership, Analysis & Project Management, and APC MRICS Certified Cost Specialist status.
With a rare blend of engineering expertise and commercial acumen, he has demonstrated exceptional capability in leading complex negotiations and maximizing project value.
Eng. Zakaria Motawe: Eng. Zakaria Motawe is a seasoned Electrical Engineer with extensive experience in designing, managing, and executing large-scale electromechanical projects across commercial, residential, and industrial developments.
He possesses deep technical expertise in electrical power distribution, ELV systems, and sustainable energy solutions, ensuring compliance with the highest engineering and safety standards.
As Engineering Lead – Electrical at MENASCO, he oversees electrical engineering operations, mentors project teams, and drives technical excellence from design through commissioning.
Mr. Ed Smith: With over two decades of international experience across the United States, India, and the Middle East, Ed Smith brings extensive leadership in quality assurance, infrastructure engineering, and project governance. Since joining MENASCO in 2017, he has led QA/QC operations across the UAE and KSA.
Ed is responsible for establishing and maintaining MENASCO's corporate Quality Management Systems (QMS), inspection protocols, and audit frameworks, ensuring full compliance with ISO 9001 standards.
A LEED Accredited Professional and Harvard Business School alumnus, Ed combines technical depth with strategic insight, fostering a culture of sustainability, accountability, and performance.
Eng. Rakan Abdullah: With over a decade of experience managing large-scale construction projects, Eng. Rakan combines strong technical engineering expertise with advanced leadership in digital project management, dedicated to advancing Building Information Modelling (BIM).

Starting his career as an Electrical Site Engineer, he built a solid foundation in design, installation, and execution before progressing into BIM Management, leading cross-functional teams and standardizing digital processes.
He holds RICS-accredited certifications and ISO 19650 qualifications, reinforcing his pursuit of global best practices in BIM management and integrated engineering solutions.

messageParagraphs: Bahaa Badawiyeh is the Chief Executive Officer of MENASCO Group, leading the organization with a philosophy that combines engineering expertise, strategic vision, operational discipline & a deep understanding of people.

Throughout his journey with MENASCO, he has played a central role in transforming the company from a growing MEP contractor into MENASCO Group, an integrated engineering organization with expanding operations across the globe.

Under his leadership, MENASCO Group has strengthened its capabilities in integrated MEP solutions, digital engineering, prefabrication, infrastructure & complex mission-critical projects. He has driven innovation-led growth, enhanced operational performance & reinforced the Group's ability to deliver reliable, precise & high-value engineering solutions.

His leadership approach is founded on the belief that engineering excellence begins with people. He promotes collaboration, accountability, knowledge-sharing & continuous development across multidisciplinary teams, empowering the Group's engineers, specialists & project leaders to perform with a shared sense of purpose.

Bahaa places strong emphasis on sustainability, ethical business practices, transparency & social responsibility. He continues to support initiatives that improve environmental performance, promote an inclusive workplace & create lasting value for clients, communities, employees & partners.
Under his direction, MENASCO Group continues to expand its regional & international capabilities while remaining firmly guided by its core values of Innovation, Integrity, Excellence.

For Bahaa, leadership is not defined by individual achievement but by the ability to unite people behind a shared vision: to build with integrity, innovate with purpose & create a legacy of engineering excellence that endures for generations.

messageParagraphs: Since founding MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C. in 1994, our ambition has remained clear: to build a trusted engineering company founded on technical excellence, integrity & unwavering commitment to our clients.

Drawing on more than five decades of experience in engineering & construction I have witnessed the industry evolve through periods of rapid growth, technological advancement & increasing project complexity. Throughout this journey MENASCO, has continued to adapt strengthen its capabilities & uphold the principles on which it was established.

Over more than three decades, MENASCO has grown into a respected name in the electromechanical contracting sector, delivering integrated MEP solutions across the UAE and key regional markets. Our expertise spans HVAC, electrical, plumbing & drainage, fire protection, BIM & digital engineering, prefabrication & specialized solutions for complex & mission-critical projects.

Our achievements have been made possible by the dedication of our people, the confidence of our clients & the enduring relationships we have built with consultants, developers, contractors, suppliers & strategic partners. Together, they have played an essential role in every milestone we have reached.

As we look to the future, we remain committed to sustainable growth, continuous improvement & the adoption of innovative engineering solutions that create lasting value, guided by our values of Innovation, Integrity, Excellence, we will continue to strengthen our capabilities, exceed our clients' expectations & contribute to building resilient communities & cities for future generations.
We look forward to creating new success stories, building enduring partnerships & continuing to transform innovation into reality.

atlas.heading: Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS)
atlas.paragraph: ATLAS is a MENASCO pilot project focussed on AI-powered compliance. The platform is being designed to evaluate engineering designs against applicable codes, standards, and regulatory frameworks to improve readiness for review before submission. From mission-critical facilities to hospitality and residential developments; ATLAS ensures we do it right the first time, every time.

lynxqc.heading: LYNX
lynxqc.paragraph: LYNX is MENASCO's intelligent field quality management platform, built to make identifying, assigning, and resolving construction issues faster and more transparent. Using photos, voice notes, and AI-assisted issue recognition, LYNX captures critical site information and routes it to the right teams for action. From initial observation through verification and closure, every issue is tracked in one auditable workflow, improving accountability, visibility, and quality across projects.

ai.heading: AI Engineering
ai.paragraph: Using AI across engineering, quantity takeoffs, recruitment, payroll management and tenders, MENASCO has increased its workforce efficiency by 30%. That time has freed our teams to take on larger projects, more of them, and to train and upskill for more impactful work.

connect.heading: MENASCO Connect
connect.paragraph: MENASCO Connect is our proprietary workforce management platform, integrating recruitment, manpower planning, site attendance, leave management, employee assessments, and internal communications into a unified digital environment. By connecting workforce forecasts with real-time deployment and personnel data, the platform streamlines administrative processes, improves resource allocation, and strengthens workforce visibility across the organization.

closing.heading: Engineering Tomorrow
closing.description: MENASCO believes the future of engineering lies in combining decades of construction expertise with intelligent technologies that improve quality, efficiency, sustainability, compliance, and project certainty. Technology is empowering our engineers to deliver better outcomes for clients and projects.

qualitySafetyPage.heading: Quality, Health & Safety
qualitySafetyPage.description: Quality, health, safety, and environmental responsibility are embedded in every stage of project delivery, guided by international standards and a commitment to continuous improvement. An integrated QHSE management system, certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018, supports consistent practices, proactive risk management, and accountability across operations.

quality.title: Technical precision, verified outcomes
quality.lead: Every installation is planned, inspected, tested and documented before it is handed over.

safety.title: Risk awareness, prevention first
safety.lead: Hazards are identified before work starts, controlled while it runs, and communicated to everyone on site.

commitment.heading: Built to International Standards
paragraphs: For our clients, quality and safety decide whether a project is delivered on time, handed over cleanly and operated without surprises. At MENASCO, both are top priorities on every project, and our work is held to internationally recognized ISO standards from the first submittal to final handover.

Safety comes first on every site. Each one runs on risk assessments and method statements, permits to work and site controls, toolbox talks and clear signage, and workforce accountability with transparent reporting.

Quality is proven before it reaches the client. Our state-of-the-art testing, commissioning and handover procedures verify that every system performs to specification, backed by complete, traceable documentation.

topics.title: International standards & certification
body: MENASCO operates an integrated management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 (quality), ISO 14001:2015 (environment) and ISO 45001:2018 (occupational health and safety). The system sets out how every project is planned, controlled, checked and improved, from tender through handover.

Our certification is maintained through regular audits by an independent certification body, alongside our own internal audits across projects and departments. Findings are tracked to closure, keeping the system alive on site, not just on paper.

topics.title: Site safety controls
body: No work starts without an approved risk assessment and method statement describing the task, its hazards and the controls in place. High-risk activities, such as work at height, hot works, lifting operations and confined spaces, require a permit to work that is issued, checked on site and formally closed out when the work is complete.

Regular toolbox talks keep teams briefed on upcoming tasks and their risks, supported by clear signage and controlled access zones. Site HSE teams carry out routine inspections, and every worker is empowered to stop unsafe work.

topics.title: Inspection & testing
body: Before installation begins, each system is planned through an inspection and test plan agreed with the consultant, defining the hold and witness points where work cannot proceed until it has been inspected and signed off.

Materials are checked against approved submittals on delivery, and installations are inspected in stages as they progress. Systems are then pressure-, function- and performance-tested to specification, with every result recorded so it can be traced back to the exact area, system and date.

topics.title: Commissioning & handover
body: Commissioning brings each system to its designed performance in a planned, witnessed sequence. Our engineers work alongside consultants, clients and specialist vendors until every system is proven to operate as intended, individually and together.

At handover, clients receive a complete, organized package of as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, test and commissioning certificates, and warranties. Operating teams are trained on the systems they inherit, and we remain responsive throughout the defects liability period.

topics.title: Training & competence
body: Every person who joins a MENASCO site completes a site induction before starting work. Skilled roles are filled by trained, certified operatives, and supervisors and engineers receive ongoing training in quality procedures, safety leadership and new technologies.
This helps ensure the right people are assigned to the right tasks, and that competence keeps pace as projects and standards evolve.

topics.title: Reporting & continuous improvement
body: Incidents, near misses, inspections and non-conformances are reported through centralized digital tools, giving management real-time visibility across every project. Each event is investigated to its root cause, and corrective actions are tracked until they are closed.
Lessons learned on one site are shared across all of them. This cycle of measuring, learning and improving is behind the results shown above, and it keeps raising the standard on every new project.

initiative.lead: Talent and ambition exist everywhere, but access to quality technical education and practical industry experience is not equally available.

faq.heading: Questions about training at MENASCO.
faq.intro: Answers about Continuing Education, MENASCO Academy, and University Internships. For anything else, our team is happy to help.

items.question: What training and certification programmes does MENASCO offer?
items.answer: MENASCO runs three programmes: Continuing Education for its own employees, MENASCO Academy, a free engineering education initiative currently in development, and University Internships that give engineering students real experience on live projects.

items.question: Who are MENASCO’s training programmes for?
items.answer: Continuing Education is for MENASCO employees. MENASCO Academy will be open to anyone aged 18 or over, with no previous education requirements. University Internships are for engineering students currently enrolled at university.

items.question: How does MENASCO support continuing education for its employees?
items.answer: Through MENASCO Connect, the company’s workforce platform, employees can access internal training resources, organisational policies, professional development materials, and structured assessments in one place.

items.question: Is Continuing Education open to people outside MENASCO?
items.answer: No. Continuing Education is an internal programme for MENASCO employees. If you are not a MENASCO employee, MENASCO Academy and University Internships are the programmes open to you.

items.question: What is MENASCO Academy?
items.answer: MENASCO Academy is a free-of-charge, private training initiative run by MENASCO and currently in development. It combines academic instruction with practical training to introduce participants to mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection engineering.

items.question: Is MENASCO Academy free?
items.answer: Yes. MENASCO Academy is free of charge for participants, regardless of their financial circumstances or educational background.

items.question: Who can join MENASCO Academy?
items.answer: Anyone aged 18 or over can join, and there are no previous education requirements. The countries where the programme will run are still to be announced.

items.question: What will MENASCO Academy students learn?
items.answer: Students will cover MEP fundamentals, building systems, technical drawings, and construction methodologies, then apply them through hands-on practical training and competency assessments.

items.question: Is the MENASCO Academy certificate accredited?
items.answer: Not at this time. MENASCO Academy certificates are private, company-issued certificates. They are not accredited by any government education body or third-party academic institution.

items.question: Will MENASCO Academy graduates be offered jobs?
items.answer: The programme is being developed to connect qualified graduates with potential employment pathways through industry placement partners across the GCC. Employment is an intended pathway, not a guaranteed outcome.

items.question: When does MENASCO Academy enrolment open?
items.answer: Enrolment has not been announced yet. You can register your interest through the Contact Us page on our website, which our team monitors consistently.

items.question: Does MENASCO offer engineering internships for university students?
items.answer: Yes. University internships give engineering students first-hand exposure to large-scale construction, working alongside experienced site teams on complex landmark developments.

items.question: How long are MENASCO internships?
items.answer: Internships run for 8 weeks (two months) and typically take place in the winter and summer, when students are on break. Some internships are also offered at other times of the year, so keep an eye on the careers portal. An internship is not a guarantee of permanent placement, but placing interns in permanent roles is our goal wherever possible.

items.question: What do interns do during a MENASCO internship?
items.answer: Most internships are a mix of on-site and in-office work. Interns see how designs are coordinated, installed, inspected, and commissioned, and gain exposure to engineering drawings, BIM coordination, technical submissions, and site quality procedures.

items.question: How do I apply for a MENASCO internship?
items.answer: Apply through the MENASCO careers portal. You can also meet our HR and Marketing teams at career fairs near you; check the Newsroom for upcoming events we will be attending.

items.question: Does MENASCO accept training partnership enquiries?
items.answer: Our training partners are already aligned internally, so we are not taking partnership enquiries at this time. If something other than training is of interest, please contact us.
